description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class for managing employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting immigration records associated with employees. The class leverages various validation rules, request parameter handling, and interacts with service and model layers to perform CRUD operations related to employee immigration data.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee immigration records, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and request handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list immigration records for a specific employee, applying search filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new immigration record for an employee, validating input parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific immigration record based on employee number and record ID, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee immigration record with provided data, after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyImmigrations
methods.description: Creates or updates an employee immigration record based on request data.
